sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def get(fr):
    wall=None; B1=None; B2=None
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
        if n['color']=='S' and n['pixels']>50:
            wall=(min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols))
        if n['color']=='B' and n['pixels'] in (48,56):
            bb=(min(rows),min(cols),max(rows),max(cols))
            if bb[1]<30: B1=bb
            else: B2=bb
    return wall,B1,B2
print("start:", get(current_frame))
action(['UP'])
print("after UP:", get(current_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
